reference:
The American horror film directed by Sidney J. Furie that is based on the alleged haunting which occurred in 1974 at Culver City, California is "The Entity." This film is inspired by the Doris Bither case, also known as the Entity hauntings, where Doris Bither alleged that ghosts of three Asian men were raping her. 

FINDING: "The Entity" is based on the Doris Bither case.
